mark: A sticker, not a plate: each mark stands on its own flat peel in a darker shade of its colour, round ones as pills, and the current mark in a list is ringed by a dashed plum line (never a solid navy ring). A group of marks is stuck down overlapping with a paper edge between them. See that the peel is flat, that nothing is blurred, and that the corner glyph stays a small clean shape.
stackbar: The bar is one pill with the second ink (sky) lying 3 px off register beside it. Pointing at a part lifts that part out of the bar 2 px on its own peel and washes its legend row mint; the threshold is a plum pearl on a thread; the legend swatches are pearls. Loading and the failed note keep the bar's height and use the shared loading and dashed empty plate.
bullets: Rows that lead somewhere take the mint wash of a hovered menu entry with the rounded entry corner instead of an underline. A figure past its threshold is a sticker on the warning or red plate with its own flat peel. The bars are pastel's own meter. Failed and nothing-due fill the list's full footprint with a normal Retry.
tick: A live number that counts wobbles once round its foot, 800 ms, like jelly, while it ticks (pastel's live change); nothing swells and nothing flashes. Press the page's button that changes the number and watch the figure rock and settle.
uptime: Every period is a tiny sticker on its own peel with a 4 px corner; the cell you point at grows upward and a focused or open cell is ringed by the dashed plum line. The share is plum, an error summary is a red sticker with a peel. Up, degraded and down still differ by shape (plain, ruled, striped), not only colour.
uptime-states: Loading shows pastel's own waiting pieces inside the strip, nothing under it moves; empty and failed keep the strip's footprint and say so in one line. The failed sentence is a red sticker on its own peel.
uptime-phone: The same sticker cells at 390 px: the strip scrolls sideways inside its box with the mask at the edge, cells keep their peel, and the info card opens under the cell it belongs to.
inbox: Rows sit on a thread of dotted pearls. The state bar on the start edge is a washi strip with round ends, 5 px wide; the next row is washed mint and its date is a mint sticker. Titles and buttons keep fixed columns and nothing touches. The buttons are pastel's own stickers.
backlog: The same list as a backlog: round-ended state bars, a group heading written as a sentence (not capitals), meta lines on the dotted rule. Done rows are quieter by ink, never faded.
files: File rows with the lead as a small sticker, dotted pearl rules between rows, and the payload opened under a row as a taped-in note: paper with a dashed edge and rounded corners.
appointments: Appointments with the next one on a mint wash and its time as a mint sticker with a flat peel; past ones go quiet by ink. The group headings read as sentences.
checks: A check that passes with a reservation is a sticker on the warning's plate with its own peel; the written-out fix is a taped-in note: mint paper in a dashed edge. A failed check keeps its red sticker. The summary line and Check again change nothing in the card's size.
sort: Pastel's own data table with the page's external sort: the sorted header carries pastel's arrow, the column that cannot be sorted now has no arrow and no pointer. Nothing on the table is redrawn by this round beyond that.
kv: Labels are quiet, values stand upright. A ruled list uses a thread of dotted pearls instead of a hairline. A changed row has a small plum pearl on its start edge and a bigger dot after its label; a row that could not be read has a red pearl, never a bar.
formrows: Settings rows on pearl threads, the pearl on the start edge for a changed or failed row, the lock as a small paper pill. Every control inside is pastel's own field, switch or button.
tiles: Choice tiles are stickers with a flat peel and the big plate corner. Pointing lifts a tile 2 px and grows the peel, pressing sticks it down flat, the chosen tile is mint paper with a plum edge and no peel, focus is the dashed line, a disabled tile is dashed with a faint peel, an invalid group gets a dashed red outline.
card-states: A card in four data states: the loading state lays the shared loading card in pastel's own waiting pieces (the caterpillar), empty is pastel's folded-corner paper, failed is the red sticker alert with a normal Retry. The card keeps its height in every state.
header: The page header's lead is a sticker mark, the title keeps its weight, the badge is pastel's sticker and the freshness line stays on its own quiet line without jumping as it ticks.
art: Pastel's own empty-state drawings: a sticker sheet. Each drawing is white paper with the sky second pass 5 units off register and one strip of mint washi tape; none, nomatch, error, offline, done and locked are a planner page, a page with a lens, a crossed-out sticker, two stickers on a broken thread, a round tick sticker and a shut planner with a padlock. On arrival the pass slides in and the paper swings down from its top-start corner, 60 ms apart, tape last.
pipeline: Each lane is a sheet of paper with its sky pass 6 px off register; the head is a sticker in the stage's colour on its own peel; cards are stickers that lift 2 px when pointed at and stick down when pressed; the open card has a plum ring; dimmed cards are dashed with no peel.
pipeline-states: Loading lays the shared loading card on the board; failed shows a dashed note with the reason as a red sticker and a normal Retry; empty lanes say so. The board keeps its size.
journey: The steps are stickers strung on a thread of pearls: a reached step is a plum sticker with a tick on its peel (or in its own colour), the step it stands at a paper sticker with its sky pass, the steps to come plain rings. The path to a closed end is a red dashed line. The dated line stands on a dotted thread.
journey-states: Loading and empty journeys keep the stepper's height; the waiting pieces are pastel's. Nothing moves when the data arrives.
contact: The contact timeline's moments are pearls on their own flat peel, planned ones dashed rings, clusters carry a count sticker, and the wait between contacts is a strip of washi tape in the tone's stripes.
contact-states: The timeline in loading, empty and failed: each keeps the footprint of the full timeline, loading uses pastel's busy card, failed has a normal Retry.
secret: The hidden value is a taped-on label: paper with a dashed edge and dots. The time left drains as a strip of washi tape along the line, peeled from its end. A read failure is a red sticker. Reveal, Hide and Copy are pastel's stickers and keep their width.
secret-phone: The same secret field in a 390 px box: the value, then the buttons wrap under it, and the tape line keeps its room so nothing moves when it fills.
manage: The dialog in sections: sections are divided by a thread of pearls, a danger section carries a round-ended bar, what still depends on the thing is a taped-in note (paper, dashed edge) and the blocked removal shows no field.
confirm: The confirmation that depends on something: the dependents list sits in a dashed-edge note on paper, the dialog arrives stuck on with the pass first as every pastel dialog does.
type-dialog: The typed confirmation in its dialog: the name to type is a marked word on mint, what would be lost is a taped-in note with a red sticker title, the field is pastel's field and the confirm button stays off until the name matches.
type-own: The same typed confirmation as a block on the page: the loses note with its red sticker title, the name on mint, a status line that turns to a plain sentence when it matches.
type-phone: The typed confirmation at 390 px: the notes and the field stack, the long name wraps inside its mint mark and never touches the edge.
disc: The timer is a round sticker with its sky pass 6 px off register, the time left a plum disc, the marks on the rim in the border ink and the hub a plum pearl. Start and Reset are pastel's own stickers.
disc-states: Running, paused and ended: paused is quieter, and an ended disc wobbles round its foot three times and keeps its pass; the status line says Time is up.
disc-phone: The disc at 390 px: it shrinks with the box, the buttons stay a normal size under it.
countdown: The countdown is a paper plate with its sky pass and one strip of washi tape across its top; the digits are plum and tabular, Start and Reset are stickers.
countdown-states: Paused greys the digits; ended wobbles the whole plate round its foot three times and keeps its pass; the status line carries the words.
range: The preset track is pastel's dashed-edge segmented control; Custom, when it is the window in force, is a sticker pressed down with a plum ring. The line under it is the exact window.
range-states: The wrong-range panel: the panel is the popover's own opaque plate under its anchor, the fields are pastel's, the invalid ones turn dashed red and a red sentence says why.
wheel: A sticker sheet round: the disc has its sky pass off register, every wedge is die-cut with a paper gap, the rim is plum, the pointer a plum triangle and Spin a plum sticker in the hub. The wheel spins on the soft landing, passes its mark a little and settles back once; the winner's name is plum and wobbles.
cook: Cook mode: what the step needs is a taped-in note (paper, dashed edge) under a small mint sticker for its title, the amounts are plum, the timer button and the Back and Next buttons are pastel's stickers, and each step arrives stuck on.
timers: Each timer is a paper plate with its sky pass and a strip of washi tape on top. The tape is stuck flat while the timer runs and lifts at its end when paused; a finished timer wobbles three times round its foot. The time is plum, the bar is pastel's.
quantity: The minus and plus are pastel's own stickers; the number sits on paper with its sky pass 3 px off register, bold and tabular; focus is the dashed line.
checklist: Rows are separated by a thread of dotted pearls, pointing washes a row mint with the rounded corner, a ticked item is struck through in plum and goes quiet, a finished group's count carries a green tick sticker. The bar is cut by a dashed line.
tri: The three-way chips: a chip that is in is a plum sticker on its peel, a chip that is out is a dashed outline with its word struck through and a red mark on its own peel, and pointing lifts any chip 2 px. The chips never change width.
code: The code block is a paper plate with its sky pass 6 px off register and a strip of washi tape at its top start; the head is cut from the body by a dashed line, the body is muted paper, keys are plum.
command: The command block is a plate stuck to the page: sky pass, tape over its top edge, the shell name a mint sticker, prompts in plum, the head and the place line cut by dashed lines. Copy is pastel's sticker and keeps its width.
command-long: A long command in the same plate: it wraps under its prompt with the hanging indent, or scrolls inside its box with the faded edge, and the tape and pass stay where they are.
command-phone: The command block at 390 px: the head keeps one line, the code wraps, nothing touches the edge.
compare: The comparison is a photo stuck down in a frame with its sky pass; the divider is a strip of washi tape in mint stripes; the handle is a round sticker on its peel that lifts when pointed at and sticks down when pressed; Before and After are small stickers.
compare-live: Loading lays the shared loading card over the frame, a failed image says so in its own pane with a normal Retry; the tape divider glides to where you press on the soft landing.
